prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[170, 120, 220, 95, 145, 195, 245]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 170 is processed last after all its children: [95, 145, 120, 195, 245, 220, 170].
